About This Game

Overview

Crazy Life is a multiplayer, board-game-style life simulation that can be played by up to six players.

Rules

The game is turn-based, with one turn representing one in-game year.
When the game ends, the player with the highest total assets wins.
Players spin a roulette wheel to determine their movement and trigger different events depending on the space they land on.

Types of space

※This image is from the Japanese version, but the full English version will be available in the final release.
Card acquisition space

You can obtain one random card out of 60 different types.
Using the cards you’ve collected allows you to gain advantages and change the flow of the game.

Card purchase space

You can purchase selected cards

money space

Random events can increase or decrease your money.

Job change space

You can change jobs to a random occupation.
There is a chance that you will not be hired.

Promotion Space

If you already have a job, landing on this space increases your Job Level.
If you are unemployed, it has the same effect as a Card Space.

salary Space

You earn a salary based on your current job and job level.

Each time you pass a Payday Space, a “Payday” is counted.
At the end of your turn, all counted “Paydays” are consumed and your salary is paid.
If you land exactly on a Payday Space, your salary is doubled.

Marriage space (Before Marriage)

You can get married by increasing your relationship level with a character you’ve exchanged contact information with.
Characters of higher rarity have unique abilities that can give you powerful advantages during the game.

Marriage space (After Marriage)

After getting married, you can have children by landing on certain spaces.
You can also increase your child’s stats as they grow.
Children take action once every three years — they can earn money or even bring you new cards!

Worst space

You may have to pay a huge fine, lose your job, or even see your properties burn down.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI was used during development to create some visual and in-game assets. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.
